site_snapshot.notes: The Ireland page exposes census affiliation, no-religion, and change metrics only; OSM place-density metrics are hidden until a governed Ireland place layer is built.

source_datasets.name: F5051: Population usually resident and present in the State by religion, sex, census year and county and city

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0); Government of Ireland copyright

source_datasets.citation: Central Statistics Office (Ireland). PxStat table F5051, population usually resident and present in the State by religion, sex, census year and county and city.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Reproduction is authorised subject to acknowledgement of the source.
source_datasets.notes: The map uses Both sexes and the 30 county-and-city rows, excluding the State row. Denominator is All religions minus Not stated; No religion remains a separate stated-response category.

source_datasets.name: Administrative Areas - National Statutory Boundaries - 2019
source_datasets.citation: Tailte Éireann. Administrative Areas - National Statutory Boundaries - 2019.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Attribute Tailte Éireann and preserve the generalised-boundary accuracy warning where relevant.
source_datasets.notes: The source has 31 administrative areas. The derived map layer dissolves Cork City Council and Cork County Council because CSO F5051 publishes Cork City and Cork County as one reporting row.

indicators.label: Religion-response denominator
indicators.description: People usually resident and present in the State with a stated religion response in the area and census year.
indicators.method: CSO F5051 All religions minus Not stated.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Ireland county-and-city reporting units; Cork City and Cork County are dissolved to match F5051.
indicators.quality_notes: This is the stated-response denominator, not the full usually resident and present population.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator reporting any stated religion.
indicators.method: 100 * (All religions - Not stated - No religion) / (All religions - Not stated).
indicators.quality_notes: Religion labels are CSO source labels; category detail changes across census products outside this broad affiliation/no-religion split.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator reporting no religion.
indicators.quality_notes: No religion is a stated response in F5051 and is not included in religious affiliation.
